title: Détail d'une recharge
description: Ouvert depuis la liste des recharges.

list.label: Voiture
list.query: SELECT __value, __text FROM (SELECT c.id AS __value, COALESCE(c.name, 'VIN ' || c.vin, 'Voiture ' || c.id) AS __text, (SELECT max(p.date) FROM positions p WHERE p.car_id = c.id AND p.ideal_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL) AS last_seen FROM cars c) x ORDER BY last_seen DESC NULLS LAST, __value DESC

options.content: 🏠 Accueil📟 Vue d'ensemble🕒 Chronologie💤 États🚗 Trajets📈 Stats conduite🧳 Voyage🛣️ Kilométrage🍃 Efficacité🔌 Recharges📊 Stats recharge⚡ Énergie réelle🔋 Santé batterie🎚️ Niveau de charge📏 Autonomie🧛 Pertes à l'arrêt🌡️ Températures📍 Lieux🗺️ Visites🗓️ Statistiques⬆️ Mises à jour🗄️ Base de données
🔌 DÉTAIL DE LA RECHARGE  —  courbe, rendement et coût de cette recharge

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood))) AS "Lieu", (SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(c.fast_charger_present) OR NULLIF(max(c.charger_phases), 0) IS NULL THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END FROM charges c WHERE c.charging_process_id = cp.id) AS "Type", cp.charge_energy_added AS "Ajouté", greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) AS "Prise",
  cp.charge_energy_added / nullif(greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used), 0) * 100 AS "Rendement", cp.duration_min * 60 AS "Durée",
  cp.start_battery_level AS "SOC début", cp.end_battery_level AS "SOC fin",
  (SELECT max(charger_power) FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) AS "Puissance max",
  cp.charge_energy_added / nullif(cp.duration_min, 0) * 60 AS "Puissance moy.",
  (cp.end_${preferred_range}_range_km - cp.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) / nullif(cp.duration_min, 0) * 60 AS "Km/h",
  cp.end_${preferred_range}_range_km - cp.start_${preferred_range}_range_km AS "Autonomie ajoutée", cp.cost AS "Coût", cp.cost / nullif(greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used), 0) AS "Prix kWh",
  cp.outside_temp_avg AS "Temp.",
  (SELECT avg(charger_voltage) FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND charger_power > 0 AND NOT COALESCE(fast_charger_present, false)) AS "Tension",
  (SELECT round(avg(charger_phases)) FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND charger_power > 0) AS "Phases"
FROM charging_processes cp LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
  LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = cp.position_id WHERE cp.id = $charge_id

panels.title: Déroulé de la recharge
panels.description: Tension, courant, autonomie et température sont masqués : clique leur nom dans la légende pour les afficher.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS time, charger_power AS "Puissance", battery_level AS "Batterie", charger_voltage AS "Tension",
  charger_actual_current AS "Courant", ${preferred_range}_battery_range_km AS "Autonomie", outside_temp AS "Temp. ext."
FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charge_id ORDER BY date
SELECT p.latitude, p.longitude, 'Ici' AS lieu FROM charging_processes cp JOIN positions p ON p.id = cp.position_id WHERE cp.id = $charge_id

panels.title: Puissance selon le niveau de batterie
panels.description: Comparée à toutes tes autres recharges du même type (AC ou DC).

targets.rawSql:
WITH sel AS (SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS dc FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charge_id),
cur AS (SELECT battery_level AS soc, max(charger_power) AS p FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charge_id AND charger_power > 0 GROUP BY 1),
ref AS (SELECT c.battery_level AS soc, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.charger_power) AS med, max(c.charger_power) AS best
        FROM charges c JOIN charging_processes x ON x.id = c.charging_process_id
        WHERE x.car_id = $car_id AND x.id <> $charge_id AND c.charger_power > 0 AND COALESCE(c.fast_charger_present, false) = (SELECT dc FROM sel)
        GROUP BY 1)
SELECT soc AS "Batterie", cur.p AS "Cette recharge", ref.med AS "Médiane des autres", ref.best AS "Meilleure"
FROM cur FULL JOIN ref USING (soc) ORDER BY 1
